title: Lines
description: Line-level domain shapes of a [[Change]]: numbered lines, line ranges, removed lines, and file side

NumberedLines.description: Consecutive lines of a file, each under its 1-based line number

Side.description: Which file numbering applies: head at the head commit, base at the base

LineNumberName.description: A 1-based line number as a property name

LineText.description: One line of text without its line break

LineRange.description: An inclusive 1-based range of consecutive lines

RemovedContent.description: The text of removed lines at the base, joined by line breaks

RemovedLines.description: Consecutive removed lines with their text at the base
